questions.stem_text:
Judge took judicial notice of some facts at the beginning of the trial. Which of the
following is not an appropriate kind of fact for judicial notice?

options.B: Facts that have been asserted by individual political organizations.
options.C: Facts recognized to be true by common knowledge.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Facts that have been asserted by individual political organizations.

questions.stem_text: Seller has a contract that specifies a delivery point. What kind of a contract is this?
In order to have an irrevocable offer under the Uniform Commercial Code, the offer must

options.A: Be made by a merchant to a merchant.
options.B: Be contained in a signed writing which gives assurance that the offer will be held open.
options.C: State the period of time for which it is irrevocable.
options.D: Not be contained in a form supplied by the offeror.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Be contained in a signed writing which gives assurance that the offer will be held open.

questions.stem_text: If a regulation does amount to a taking, then what must the government do?

options.A: Pay just compensation for the property
options.B: Terminate the regulation and pay damages that occurred while regulation was in effect
options.C: Pay double damages if not addressed in 30 days.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - a or b

questions.stem_text: Which is the hierarchy of U.S. Law?

options.A: Executive agreements, U.S. Constitution, treaties and federal statutes, state law
options.B: U.S constitution, treaties and federal statutes, executive agreements, state law
options.C: Treaties and federal statutes, US Constitution, executive agreements, state law
options.D: U.S constitution, executive agreements, treaties and federal statutes, state law

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - U.S constitution, treaties and federal statutes, executive agreements, state law
